mapper.select: SELECT a.alba_id AS albaId, s.schedule_id AS scheduleId, w.work_id AS workId, w.work_in AS workIn, w.work_out AS workOut FROM alba a INNER JOIN schedule s ON a.alba_id = s.alba_id LEFT JOIN work w ON a.alba_id = w.alba_id AND DATE(work_in) = #{date} WHERE s.schedule_time = #{scheduleTime} AND a.store_id = #{storeId} AND a.is_active = b'1' ORDER BY a.alba_id

SELECT DISTINCT w.alba_id AS albaId, w.work_date AS workDate, w.work_in AS workIn, w.work_out AS workOut, w.work_status AS workStatus FROM work w INNER JOIN alba a ON a.alba_id = w.alba_id WHERE w.alba_id = #{albaId} AND w.work_date = #{date} AND a.store_id = #{storeId} AND a.is_active = b'1'
